name: Teable
description: Reads and updates records, tables, fields and views in Teable, a Postgres-backed AI spreadsheet, from Claude Code, Codex or Cursor via its hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Read and Write Records
skills.description: Reads and writes Teable records from an MCP client, acting with the same permissions you hold in each project.

skills.name: Manage Tables and Views
skills.description: Creates tables, fields and views in Teable from plain-language requests in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or claude.ai.

skills.name: Call the Teable API
skills.description: Calls the Teable REST API with personal access tokens scoped to chosen spaces, projects and permissions, for CI and scripts.

skills.name: Build Apps Locally
skills.description: Clones, edits, pushes and publishes App Builder apps from your computer through the Teable CLI and agent skill.
